Drawing DWG-C-0004 rev A, sheet 1/1: System C – coolant loop schematic.
Components:
- C-STK: Fuel cell stack
- C-CLP: Electric coolant pump
- C-RAD: Heat exchanger (CHP circuit)
Line list:
- L11 Coolant from C-CLP (Electric coolant pump) to C-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L12 Coolant from C-STK (Fuel cell stack) to C-RAD (Heat exchanger (CHP circuit))
- L13 Coolant from C-RAD (Heat exchanger (CHP circuit)) to C-CLP (Electric coolant pump)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
